title: Linux streaming
wikitext:
This is for linux. In my setup i use RX580 on local box with COMPOSITE enabled in xorg.conf (default)
  You need:
  gpu-screen-recoder
  wmctrl 
  xdotool

  Use vid_fullscreen 1 and vid_minimize_on_focus_loss 1 

This will unminimize the ezquake window before starting capture, it will still capture a blank window when it's minimized. 

  wmctrl -ia $(xdotool search --pid $(pgrep ezquake)) && gpu-screen-recorder     -w $(xdotool search --pid $(pgrep ezquake)) -k hevc -bm qp -c mkv  -f 120 -a "app:ezQuake" -s 1280x720   -o tcp://192.168.1.3:1337/test.mkv
I also use a re-encode box because the command above is buggy and creates choppy/stuttering video, however, re-encoding it on another box fixes it

On the re-encode box (with 970 in my example) i use this:
  ffmpeg -re  -i tcp://192.168.1.3:1337?listen -c:v h264_nvenc -preset p4 -g 240 -keyint_min 120 -b:v 4300k -minrate 4300k -maxrate 4300k -c:a aac  -strict normal -bufsize 4300k -f flv "rtmp://live.twitch.tv/app/$KEY"
